---
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

<!-- Post-purchase welcome page. Not in the navbar/sidebar — reached from the Lemon
     Squeezy confirmation modal + email receipt buttons (…/welcome.html?key=[license_key]).
     Sequential wizard carousel: the buyer's license key is shown large and permanently
     above the steps, then one step at a time — (1) first install vs. already-have-the-trial,
     (2) activate graphically (JackMate) or in the terminal, (3) start using it. The Next
     button unlocks only once the current step is answered; Back returns. -->

```{=html}
<div class="dl-page">
  <img src="assets/icon.png" alt="JackMoebius" class="dl-icon">
  <h1>Welcome to JackMoebius</h1>
  <p id="dl-greeting" class="dl-greeting">Thanks for your purchase, <span id="dl-name"></span>&nbsp;!</p>
  <div class="dl-trust">
    <span class="fa-stack hero-seal" aria-hidden="true">
      <i class="fa-solid fa-certificate fa-stack-2x"></i>
      <i class="fa-solid fa-check fa-stack-1x"></i>
    </span>
    Signed &amp; notarized by Apple
  </div>

  <!-- License key: shown large and permanently above the steps -->
  <div id="dl-key-line" class="dl-keybox">
    <span class="dl-keybox-label">Your license key</span>
    <span class="dl-keybox-row">
      <code id="dl-key"></code>
      <button id="dl-key-copy" type="button" class="dl-copybtn">Copy</button>
    </span>
  </div>

  <!-- Sequential wizard: one step at a time; Next unlocks once the step is answered -->
  <div class="wiz-card">
  <div class="wiz">
    <div class="wiz-track" id="wiz-track">

      <!-- STEP 1 -->
      <section class="wiz-slide" data-step="1">
        <p class="dl-steptitle">Is this a first install, or do you already have it?</p>
        <div class="dl-choices">
          <button type="button" class="dl-choice" id="ch-new">Installing for the first time</button>
          <button type="button" class="dl-choice" id="ch-have">I already have it (from the trial)</button>
        </div>

        <div class="dl-note dl-panel" id="panel-new" hidden>
          <div class="dl-dl">
            <a class="hero-pill hero-pill-primary dl-btn" id="download-btn" onclick="openDownloadModal(event)"
               href="https://github.com/zinc75/JackMoebius/releases/download/v{{< var jackmoebius-version >}}/JackMoebius-{{< var jackmoebius-version >}}.dmg">
              <i class="fa-brands fa-apple"></i>
              Download JackMoebius {{< var jackmoebius-version >}}
            </a>
          </div>
          <ol class="dl-steps">
            <li>Open the downloaded <strong>.dmg</strong>.</li>
            <li>Run <strong>Install JackMoebius.pkg</strong> and follow the installer — it also
                offers <strong>JackMate</strong> (the free JACK patchbay &amp; manager) as an
                optional component; keeping it ticked is the easiest way to drive JackMoebius.</li>
            <li>macOS asks you to <strong>restart</strong> — the audio driver loads at the next boot.</li>
          </ol>
        </div>

        <div class="dl-note dl-panel dl-reinstall" id="panel-have" hidden>
          Great — <strong>no need to reinstall</strong>. Move on to activation.
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- STEP 2 -->
      <section class="wiz-slide" data-step="2">
        <p class="dl-steptitle">Activate your license</p>
        <div class="dl-choices">
          <button type="button" class="dl-choice dl-choice-2" id="act-gui">
            <span class="dl-choice-t"><i class="fa-solid fa-hand-pointer"></i> I'd rather click</span>
            <span class="dl-choice-s">Graphically, in JackMate</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="dl-choice dl-choice-2" id="act-cli">
            <span class="dl-choice-t"><i class="fa-solid fa-terminal"></i> I'd rather type</span>
            <span class="dl-choice-s">One command in Terminal</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="dl-note dl-panel" id="panel-act-gui" hidden>
          <p>One click and JackMate opens with your key ready:</p>
          <div class="dl-dl">
            <a class="hero-pill hero-pill-primary dl-btn" id="open-jackmate" href="jackmate://activate">
              <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i>
              Open in JackMate
            </a>
          </div>
          <p class="dl-lead">Nothing happens? Activate manually: in
             <a href="https://zinc75.github.io/JackMate">JackMate</a>, open the
             <strong>License</strong> panel, paste your key above, and click <strong>Activate</strong>.</p>
          <!-- VIDEO: short muted clip showing where to click in JackMate's License panel.
               Lives at assets/video/activate-jackmoebius-from-jackmate.mp4; the src below wires
               it in and onloadedmetadata removes the .is-empty placeholder automatically. -->
          <figure class="dl-vid is-empty">
            <video class="scroll-video" src="assets/video/activate-jackmoebius-from-jackmate.mp4" muted playsinline preload="metadata"
                   onloadedmetadata="this.closest('figure').classList.remove('is-empty'); if(window.wizFit) window.wizFit();"></video>
            <figcaption class="dl-vid-ph"><i class="fa-solid fa-clapperboard"></i>
              Short walkthrough coming soon.</figcaption>
          </figure>
        </div>

        <div class="dl-note dl-panel" id="panel-act-cli" hidden>
          <p>Open <strong>Terminal</strong> and run:</p>
          <div class="dl-cmd">
            <code id="dl-cmd">jackmoebius license activate YOUR-KEY</code>
            <button id="dl-copy" type="button" class="dl-copybtn">Copy</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- STEP 3 -->
      <section class="wiz-slide" data-step="3">
        <p class="dl-steptitle">Start using it</p>
        <div class="dl-note">
          Start a <strong>JACK</strong> server (via <a href="https://zinc75.github.io/JackMate">JackMate</a>),
          then expose your apps in JackMoebius. Enjoy!
        </div>
      </section>

    </div><!-- /wiz-track -->
  </div><!-- /wiz -->

  <div class="wiz-nav">
    <button type="button" class="wiz-btn wiz-back" id="wiz-back" hidden>
      <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-left"></i> Back
    </button>
    <div class="wiz-dots" id="wiz-dots" aria-hidden="true">
      <span class="wiz-dot"></span><span class="wiz-dot"></span><span class="wiz-dot"></span>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="wiz-btn wiz-next" id="wiz-next" disabled>
      Next <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i>
    </button>
  </div>
  </div><!-- /wiz-card -->
</div>

<!-- Wrong-platform modals — same behaviour as the site's Download button. macOS just
     downloads (this page already shows the install steps); non-Mac gets a heads-up. -->
<div id="dm-confirm-modal" class="dm-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dm-confirm-title">
  <div class="dm-dialog dm-dialog-sm">
    <div class="dm-header">
      <div class="dm-header-icon icon-bg-violet"><i class="fa-brands fa-apple"></i></div>
      <div>
        <h2 id="dm-confirm-title" class="dm-title">JackMoebius is a macOS driver</h2>
        <p class="dm-intro">This installer only runs on macOS. Download anyway?</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dm-footer">
      <button class="dm-cancel-btn" id="dm-confirm-cancel">Cancel</button>
      <button class="dm-close-btn" id="dm-confirm-ok">Download anyway</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="dm-mobile-modal" class="dm-overlay" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dm-mobile-title">
  <div class="dm-dialog dm-dialog-sm">
    <div class="dm-header">
      <div class="dm-header-icon icon-bg-violet"><i class="fa-brands fa-apple"></i></div>
      <div>
        <h2 id="dm-mobile-title" class="dm-title">JackMoebius is a macOS driver</h2>
        <p class="dm-intro">It's a CoreAudio driver for the Mac — it can't run on iPhone or iPad. Come back from a Mac to download it.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="dm-footer dm-footer-end">
      <button class="dm-close-btn" id="dm-mobile-ok">Got it</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<style>
  .dl-page { max-width: 660px; margin: 3rem auto 4rem; text-align: center; }
  .dl-icon { width: 88px; height: 88px; border-radius: 20px; }
  .dl-page h1 { margin: 1rem 0 .6rem; }
  .dl-greeting { display: none; color: var(--jm-text-dim); margin: 0 0 1.1rem; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  .dl-greeting #dl-name { color: var(--jm-text); font-weight: 600; }
  .dl-trust { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: 0 0 2rem;
              color: var(--jm-text-dim); font-weight: 500; }

  /* License key box — always above the steps */
  .dl-keybox { display: none; margin: 0 auto 2.2rem; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; max-width: 540px;
               background: var(--jm-bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); border-radius: 14px; }
  .dl-keybox-label { display: block; color: var(--jm-text-dim); font-size: .78rem;
                     text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; margin-bottom: .55rem; }
  .dl-keybox-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; }
  .dl-keybox code { color: var(--jm-text); background: rgba(0,0,0,.28); padding: .5rem .8rem;
                    border-radius: 10px; font-size: 1.15rem; letter-spacing: .02em; word-break: break-all; }

  /* Wizard carousel */
  .wiz-card { border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); border-radius: 16px; padding: 1.6rem 1.6rem 1.3rem; }
  .wiz { overflow: hidden; transition: height .3s ease; }
  .wiz-track { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; transition: transform .35s ease; }
  .wiz-slide { flex: 0 0 100%; min-width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .2rem; text-align: left; }

  .dl-steptitle { font-weight: 700; color: var(--jm-text); margin: 0 0 .9rem; font-size: 1.05rem; text-align: center; }
  .dl-choices { display: flex; gap: .7rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .dl-choice { flex: 1 1 210px; cursor: pointer; padding: .8rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px;
               border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); background: var(--jm-bg-card);
               color: var(--jm-text-dim); font-size: .95rem; text-align: center; transition: all .12s; }
  .dl-choice:hover { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: var(--jm-border-hi); }
  .dl-choice.active { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: #38bdf8; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #38bdf8; }
  .dl-choice-2 { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .15rem; }
  .dl-choice-2 .dl-choice-t { font-weight: 600; color: var(--jm-text); font-size: .95rem; }
  .dl-choice-2 .dl-choice-s { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--jm-text-dim); }

  .dl-panel { margin-top: 1rem; }
  .dl-dl { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .dl-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; }
  .dl-steps { margin: 1rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.85; }
  .dl-note { color: var(--jm-text-dim); background: var(--jm-bg-card); text-align: left;
             border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); border-radius: 14px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; }
  .dl-note p { margin: 0 0 .6rem; }
  .dl-note p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .dl-reinstall { border-left: 3px solid #38bdf8; }

  .dl-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .dl-cmd code { flex: 1 1 auto; background: rgba(0,0,0,.25); padding: .45rem .65rem;
                 border-radius: 8px; word-break: break-all; }
  .dl-copybtn { flex: none; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med);
                background: transparent; color: var(--jm-text-dim); border-radius: 8px;
                padding: .35rem .75rem; font-size: .82rem; }
  .dl-copybtn:hover { color: var(--jm-text); border-color: var(--jm-border-hi); }

  .dl-vid { margin: .2rem 0 0; }
  .dl-vid video { display: block; width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); }
  .dl-vid-ph { display: none; padding: 1.4rem 1rem; border: 1px dashed var(--jm-border-hi);
               border-radius: 10px; color: var(--jm-muted); text-align: center; font-size: .85rem; }
  .dl-vid.is-empty video { display: none; }
  .dl-vid.is-empty .dl-vid-ph { display: block; }

  /* Wizard nav */
  .wiz-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 1.6rem; }
  .wiz-btn { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem;
             border: 1px solid var(--jm-border-med); background: var(--jm-bg-card); color: var(--jm-text);
             border-radius: 10px; padding: .55rem 1.1rem; font-size: .95rem; transition: all .12s; }
  .wiz-btn[hidden] { display: none; }
  .wiz-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--jm-border-hi); }
  .wiz-btn:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .wiz-next { background: #38bdf8; border-color: #38bdf8; color: #051016; font-weight: 600; }
  .wiz-next:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.07); }
  .wiz-dots { display: inline-flex; gap: .45rem; flex: 1; justify-content: center; }
  .wiz-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--jm-border-hi); transition: all .2s; }
  .wiz-dot.active { background: #38bdf8; transform: scale(1.25); }
</style>

<script>
  window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    var track = document.getElementById('wiz-track');
    var wiz = track.parentElement;
    var slides = Array.prototype.slice.call(track.querySelectorAll('.wiz-slide'));
    var dots = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.wiz-dot'));
    var btnBack = document.getElementById('wiz-back'), btnNext = document.getElementById('wiz-next');
    var current = 0;                        // 0-based slide index
    var answered = [false, false, true];    // step 3 asks nothing

    // Fit the carousel height to the current slide (content grows as panels reveal).
    window.wizFit = function () { wiz.style.height = slides[current].offsetHeight + 'px'; };

    // Tiny self-contained confetti burst for the final step (no dependency).
    function burstConfetti() {
      var c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999';
      document.body.appendChild(c);
      var ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      c.width = innerWidth; c.height = innerHeight;
      var colors = ['#38bdf8', '#a78bfa', '#34d399', '#fbbf24', '#f472b6', '#f87171'];
      var parts = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < 140; i++) parts.push({
        x: innerWidth / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 140,
        y: innerHeight * 0.34 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 11, vy: Math.random() * -9 - 3,
        g: 0.22 + Math.random() * 0.12, s: 5 + Math.random() * 6,
        rot: Math.random() * 6.28, vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        col: colors[i % colors.length]
      });
      var t0 = performance.now();
      (function frame(now) {
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
        var fade = Math.max(0, 1 - (now - t0) / 2200);
        parts.forEach(function (p) {
          p.vy += p.g; p.x += p.vx; p.y += p.vy; p.rot += p.vr;
          ctx.save(); ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(p.rot);
          ctx.globalAlpha = fade; ctx.fillStyle = p.col;
          ctx.fillRect(-p.s / 2, -p.s / 2, p.s, p.s * 0.6); ctx.restore();
        });
        if (now - t0 < 2400) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else c.remove();
      })(t0);
    }

    function render() {
      track.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (-current * 100) + '%)';
      slides.forEach(function (s, i) {
        if (i === current) s.removeAttribute('inert'); else s.setAttribute('inert', '');
      });
      dots.forEach(function (d, i) { d.classList.toggle('active', i === current); });
      btnBack.hidden = current === 0;
      var last = current === slides.length - 1;
      btnNext.hidden = last;
      btnNext.disabled = !answered[current];
      window.wizFit();
    }
    var confettiDone = false;
    function go(i) {
      current = Math.max(0, Math.min(slides.length - 1, i));
      render();
      if (current === slides.length - 1 && !confettiDone &&
          !matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        confettiDone = true; burstConfetti();
      }
    }
    btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () { if (answered[current]) go(current + 1); });
    btnBack.addEventListener('click', function () { go(current - 1); });

    // Step 1: first install vs. already have it.
    var chNew = document.getElementById('ch-new'), chHave = document.getElementById('ch-have');
    var panelNew = document.getElementById('panel-new'), panelHave = document.getElementById('panel-have');
    function choose(isNew) {
      panelNew.hidden = !isNew; panelHave.hidden = isNew;
      chNew.classList.toggle('active', isNew);
      chHave.classList.toggle('active', !isNew);
      answered[0] = true; btnNext.disabled = false; window.wizFit();
    }
    chNew.addEventListener('click', function () { choose(true); });
    chHave.addEventListener('click', function () { choose(false); });

    // Step 2: activate graphically (JackMate) vs. the terminal.
    var actGui = document.getElementById('act-gui'), actCli = document.getElementById('act-cli');
    var panelActGui = document.getElementById('panel-act-gui'), panelActCli = document.getElementById('panel-act-cli');
    function chooseAct(gui) {
      panelActGui.hidden = !gui; panelActCli.hidden = gui;
      actGui.classList.toggle('active', gui);
      actCli.classList.toggle('active', !gui);
      answered[1] = true; btnNext.disabled = false; window.wizFit();
    }
    actGui.addEventListener('click', function () { chooseAct(true); });
    actCli.addEventListener('click', function () { chooseAct(false); });

    // License key from the URL (?key= — Lemon Squeezy's form — or a #fragment).
    // textContent keeps it XSS-safe.
    function readKey() {
      var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('key');
      if (q && /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}$/.test(q)) return q;
      var raw = decodeURIComponent((location.hash || '').replace(/^#(?:key=)?/, '')).trim();
      return /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,}$/.test(raw) ? raw : null;
    }
    var key = readKey();
    if (key) {
      document.getElementById('dl-key').textContent = key;
      document.getElementById('dl-key-line').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('dl-cmd').textContent = 'jackmoebius license activate ' + key;
      // Deep-link the graphical button into JackMate with the key prefilled (best-effort;
      // if JackMate isn't installed, the video + manual steps below are the fallback).
      var openJM = document.getElementById('open-jackmate');
      if (openJM) openJM.href = 'jackmate://activate?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key);
    }

    // Optional: greet the buyer by name (Lemon Squeezy's [name] variable). textContent-safe.
    var nm = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('name');
    if (nm && (nm = nm.trim()) && nm.length <= 60) {
      document.getElementById('dl-name').textContent = nm;
      document.getElementById('dl-greeting').style.display = 'block';
    }

    function wireCopy(btnId, srcId) {
      var btn = document.getElementById(btnId), src = document.getElementById(srcId);
      if (!btn || !src) return;
      btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(src.textContent);
        var t = btn.textContent; btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
        setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = t; }, 1500);
      });
    }
    wireCopy('dl-key-copy', 'dl-key');
    wireCopy('dl-copy', 'dl-cmd');

    window.addEventListener('resize', function () { window.wizFit(); });
    window.addEventListener('load', function () { window.wizFit(); });  // late fonts/icons
    render();  // initial paint
  });
</script>
```
